name: list_windows
title: List top-level windows
description: Read-only triage of visible top-level windows. Returns hwnd/pid/process/class/bounds, whether the window is on this session's virtual display, whether its pid is tracked by this session, and whether it runs at a higher integrity level. Titles of unmanaged windows are redacted (title_redacted=true), so title_contains only matches tracked windows. Reads all top-level windows in the session; run in a trusted environment. Use it before launch_or_place_app(hwnd=...) when a dialog or popup is not reachable through snapshot.

scope.description: Default all. tracked = pid belongs to a tracked app; unmanaged = everything else.

include_offscreen.description: Default true. false only returns windows whose center is on the virtual display.

title_contains.description: Case-insensitive substring filter on titles. Only effective for tracked windows; unmanaged titles are redacted.
